mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 20 trading days signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces non-significant positive 20d returns (p > 0.05) during FEDFUNDS decline, or the IC rank is ≥0.03 over any 20-day window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 0.3% in the next 5 trading days triggers investor pessimism about labor market health, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the subsequent 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during UNRATE crossings above 0.3%, or the IC rank is ≥0.03 over any 5-day window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS (monetary tightening) and decline in GDPC1 (demand weakening) creates conflicting signals, reducing market confidence and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during FEDFUNDS up and GDPC1 down, or the IC rank is ≥0.03 over any 60-day window.

mechanism_narrative: Low CPIAUCSL (inflation) during a late-cycle expansion indicates the Fed may maintain accommodative policy, fostering optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during low CPIAUCSL in late-cycle expansions, or the IC rank is ≥0.03 over any 20-day window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong growth in INDPRO (supply expansion) reduces inflation expectations, lowering risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during high INDPRO, or the IC rank is ≥0.03 over any 5-day window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in PAYEMS below 150,000 in the next 2 months signals labor market weakness, prompting fears of recession and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the subsequent 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during PAYEMS drops below 150,000, or the IC rank is ≥0.03 over any 60-day window.

mechanism_narrative: High demand (GDPC1) coupled with low supply (INDPRO) creates inflationary pressure, raising risk aversion and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during high GDPC1 and low INDPRO, or the IC rank is ≥0.03 over any 20-day window.

mechanism_narrative: A recovery in FEDFUNDS from elevated levels to moderate rates during a post-shock period signals policy normalization, boosting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during FEDFUNDS normalization in post-shock recovery, or the IC rank is ≥0.03 over any 5-day window.
